# PASCO Scientific

> > PASCO is a leading provider of educational science equipment, sensors, and software for physics, chemistry, biology, and STEM education.

PASCO offers comprehensive solutions including wireless sensors (PASPORT and Wireless Sensors), data collection software (PASCO Capstone, SPARKvue, Chemvue), complete experiment kits, and lab manuals designed for K-12 and higher education science curricula. The company supports hands-on learning through integrated hardware and software platforms, with specialized tools for physics, chemistry, biology, and agricultural science education.

## Key Topics

- PASPORT Sensors
- Wireless Sensors
- PASCO Capstone
- SPARKvue
- Data Collection
- Physics Equipment
- Chemistry Software
- Complete Experiments
- PASCO Academy
- Chemvue
- Spectrometry
- PASPORT Interfaces
- Wireless Weather Sensor with GPS
- Beer's Law
- Scientific Software

## Sensors & Data Collection

- [Wireless Spectrometer (Vis) - PS-2600](https://www.pasco.com/products/sensors/wireless/wireless-spectrometer-vis): Wireless Spectrometer (PS-2600) for chemistry, biology & physics labs
- [Wireless Voltage-Current Sensor - PS-4254](https://www.pasco.com/products/sensors/voltage-and-current/wireless-voltage-current-sensor): Wireless Voltage-Current Sensor (PS-4254) with OLED display & power calc
- [PASPORT Absolute Pressure Sensor - PS-2107](https://www.pasco.com/products/sensors/pasport/pasport-absolute-pressure-sensor): PASPORT Absolute Pressure Sensor (PS-2107) for gas laws & chemistry
- [Smart Gate - PS-2180](https://www.pasco.com/products/sensors/pasport/smart-gate): Smart Gate photogate (PS-2180) for PASPORT with double beam speed measure
- [PASPORT Galvanometer - PS-2160](https://www.pasco.com/products/sensors/pasport/pasport-galvanometer): PASPORT Galvanometer (PS-2160) for high-resolution voltage measurement
- [PASPORT Dual Load Cell Amplifier - PS-2205](https://www.pasco.com/products/sensors/pasport/pasport-dual-load-cell-amplifier): PASPORT Dual Load Cell Amplifier (PS-2205) for force measurement
- [PASPORT Skin/Surface Temperature Probe - PS-2131](https://www.pasco.com/products/sensors/temperature/pasport-skin-surface-temperature-probe): PASPORT Skin/Surface Temperature Probe (PS-2131) for varied surfaces
